reminders.title: macOS Reminders
reminders.description: Sync tasks with due dates to the selected list. Date and completion changes in Reminders sync back to saved notes.
reminders.macOnly: Available in the macOS desktop app only.
reminders.disableHint: Disabling stops sync. Reminders already created will remain.
reminders.noLists: No writable lists found. Create a list in Apple Reminders, then load lists again.
reminders.saveHint: Takes effect after saving. Date-only tasks notify at 09:00.
reminders.enableHint: Enable macOS Reminders sync in Settings. Save the note to apply changes.
reminders.conflictHint: Both sides changed the same field. Choose which side to keep for conflicting fields; other changes will still merge.

mindmap.title: Mind maps
mindmap.dragHint: Drop in the center to make a child, or at the top or bottom to reorder; layout updates automatically
mindmap.openVault: Open a local vault in Settings first.
mindmap.shortcuts: Click a node to edit its text: Enter confirms, Shift+Enter inserts a new line, Esc cancels. With the canvas focused, Tab adds a child, Enter adds a sibling, Delete removes a branch; Ctrl / Cmd + Z undoes changes.
mindmap.importHint: Supports FreeMind (.mm), OPML, iNote mind map JSON, and native MindNode import in the desktop app. Each file creates a new note; originals remain unchanged. Limits: 10 MiB, 5000 nodes, 64 levels per file; 100 files per batch.
mindmap.mindnodeHint: Native import supports MindNode Classic internal formats 6 and 9 in packages or ZIP single files. Text, hierarchy, order, notes, links and folding are preserved. Use “Choose MindNode package folder” if the package appears as a directory. For other versions, export as FreeMind or OPML first.

errors.invalid: Invalid mind map structure. Check the file or open its source to repair.
errors.limit: Map exceeds a limit: 10 MiB, 5000 nodes or 64 levels.
errors.mindnode: Could not import this MindNode document. Check its completeness and supported version.
errors.format: Unsupported format. Choose .mm, .opml or iNote mind map JSON.
errors.xml: Invalid XML, or unsupported DTD/entity declaration.
errors.read: Could not read this file. Check permissions and UTF-8 encoding.
errors.export: Export failed. Try again or choose another location.
errors.batch: Choose at most 100 files per batch.
errors.mindnodeDesktop: Select native MindNode files in the iNote desktop app. For browser previews, use FreeMind or OPML.
errors.mindnodeVersion: Unsupported MindNode internal format version. Formats 6 and 9 are supported. Export as FreeMind or OPML in MindNode first.
errors.mindnodeSchema: Unrecognized MindNode document or container. Packages must contain contents.xml; single files must be a plist or a ZIP containing that document.

warnings.appearance: Some styles, icons, positions or cross-links are not supported; review the imported map.
warnings.richText: Rich text was converted to plain text; formatting was removed.
warnings.images: Images were not imported. Keep the original file.
warnings.duplicateIds: Duplicate node IDs were replaced with unique IDs.
warnings.mindnodeIds: Missing or duplicate node IDs were replaced with unique IDs.
warnings.mindnodeAttachments: Images, stickers or other attachments were not imported. Keep the original document.
warnings.mindnodeFeatures: Node tasks, tags or sticker properties were not migrated. Compare with the original.
warnings.mindnodeConnections: Cross-links or boundaries were not imported. Parent/child hierarchy is preserved.
warnings.mindnodeLinks: This node has multiple links. Extra links were retained in its notes.

mindmap.agentHint: Edit mind map nodes in the canvas or outline. The note body is a generated, searchable outline; AI editing of map notes is not available yet.

exportHints.json: Full backup: preserves node IDs, notes, links, colors and folding. Can be reimported.
exportHints.mm: Exports structure, text, notes, links, colors and folding. Multiple roots are grouped under one central topic.
exportHints.opml: Exports structure, text, notes and links. Colors and folding are omitted.
exportHints.md: Exports a readable outline. Use iNote JSON for a full backup.

mindmap.editHint: Click to edit; Enter to confirm, Shift+Enter for a new line, Esc to cancel
